mapper.insert: insert into notifications (receiver_type, receiver_id, receiver_scope, category, title, content) values (#{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverScope}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: select id, receiver_scope, category, title, content, read_at, created_at from notifications where receiver_scope = #{receiverScope} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by id desc
mapper.update: update notifications set read_at = current_timestamp where id = #{notificationId}
update notifications set read_at = current_timestamp where receiver_scope = #{receiverScope} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and read_at is null
